comment: Every constant the simulation uses. Tune here, never in code. These values are the medians of the viable region found by sweep.py over the full system including rival Messengers - not hand-picked. Re-run the sweep after any structural change; adding Messengers invalidated the previous tuning entirely.
comment_decay_flat: Raw attention each myth loses per tick regardless of size. Flat decay kills obscure myths first, which is the point.
comment_decay_proportional: Additional fractional decay. Keeps large myths from being immortal.
comment_native: --- native telling: people retell their own stories whether or not the player is there. Without this the world has no homeostasis and every region monocultures on its own.
comment_native_tradition_share: Fraction of the native budget split evenly across myths native to the region (the tradition floor, stabilising). The rest follows current share (reinforcing).
comment_native_fashion_damping: Exponent on (1 - share) damping native retelling of already-saturated myths: everyone has heard it. 0 = pure rich-get-richer and the world monocultures on its own; 1 = populations self-regulate and only the player can push a region into Bleed.
comment_telling_gain: Raw attention added when the player tells a story once, before transmission scaling.
comment_extinction_floor: Raw weight below this is treated as zero. The myth is regionally extinct.
comment_last_telling_share: Belief share below which a last-telling event fires, offering one chance to save the myth.
comment_bind_threshold: Belief share a myth needs in a region before the player can collect its verses there. You cannot learn a story nobody tells any more. This is what makes a fading myth a prize rather than only a tragedy: reviving it is the sole route to binding it.
comment_bleed_threshold: Dominant myth's belief share above which terrain starts transmuting. Set from sweep.py: the viable range is 0.52-0.75 and 0.65 is its median. The original hand-tuned 0.55 sat on the bottom edge and was marginal.
comment_bleed_rate: How fast bleed accrues at full saturation overshoot.
comment_bleed_recovery: How fast bleed heals when the dominant share drops back below threshold.
comment_bleed_feedback: Raw attention the transmuted land itself feeds back into the dominant myth each tick. This is the runaway term - the land proving the story.
comment_point_of_no_return: Bleed level past which feedback sustains itself and recovery can no longer win.
comment_population_bleed_onset: Bleed level at which people start dying or leaving.
comment_population_loss_rate: Fraction of population lost per tick at full bleed.
comment_refugee_fraction: Of the people displaced, how many reach a neighbor rather than dying.
comment_refugee_carry: How loudly refugees tell their stories in the place that shelters them, as a multiplier on their share of the new population. Above 1 because the displaced are disproportionately vocal about the myth that just took their home. This is the only route by which Bleed crosses a border.
comment_sterile_population: Below this, the region can no longer hold any story. Mythically sterile, permanently.
comment_vitality_thin: Total raw attention below which a region is thin and featureless - under-belief as its own death.
comment_ticks: Length of a scenario run. One tick is roughly a week of in-world time.
comment_maintainer_vigor: Multiplier on telling_gain for a maintainer propping up the weakest local story. Set from the vigor/native probe: at 1.0 maintainers neuter the player entirely (monoculture stops sterilising anything) and prop every faint myth past bind_threshold, erasing the scarcity that makes binding interesting. At 0.25 the world still holds, the player can still wreck a valley, and deliberate collecting still beats doing nothing by ~3 myths.
comment_contest_swing: Fraction of a region's total attention that changes hands in a decisive contest. The slider's travel.
comment_contest_deadzone: Standing margin below which the room is too evenly split to call and no contest resolves.
comment_bound_floor: Minimum belief share a myth keeps in a region while a Messenger who has bound it is present. Stops a losing streak spiralling: you still carry that story and you are standing right there telling it.
comment_contest_saturation_damping: Exponent on (1 - winner's standing) damping what a contest win actually earns. Without it contests run away: winning raises standing, which wins more contests, and the player went 356-1 against every rival in the valley. You cannot win more of a room for a story it already believes.
comment_rival_repertoire_cap: How many myths a rival Messenger can carry. They bind by the same rule as the player, otherwise their standing is static while the player's grows all game and they lose every contest regardless of tuning.
comment_native_telling_per_myth: Native telling budget PER MYTH the region knows, replacing the old flat per-region budget. decay_flat is charged per myth, so a flat budget meant regional decay scaled with myth count while supply did not: at 25 myths per region decay outran telling 6:1 and 78% of stories died. A village that knows thirty stories tells thirty stories. Calibrated so a 4-myth region matches the old flat 0.026.
comment_bleed_visible: Bleed level at which the land has visibly changed enough to tell the player something is happening. Ambient drift in an unattended world peaks around 0.11 while player-caused Bleed runs to 1.0, so a bar in between keeps the ledger alive and breathing without ever showing the player a region turning that they did not cause. Attribution stays clean.
